cases.name: a-formula-that-names-a-column-that-is-not-there
cases.description: A typo in expr= used to reach the engine and die there. The name is checked against the sequences declared ABOVE this one, which is also what makes the answer the same on every engine.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="Traffic"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="F"><gen type="formula" expr="Trafic * 2"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{F}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-formula-that-names-a-column-declared-below-it
cases.description: Worse than a typo: the streaming registry answers a forward reference and the in-memory one does not, so one config would mean two datasets. Refused before either engine is chosen.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="F"><gen type="formula" expr="Later * 2"/></sequence><sequence name="Later"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{F}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-distribution-parameter-that-names-a-column-that-is-not-there
cases.description: The same rule for a parameter written as an expression. Without it the run said only that lambda must be a number, which names the symptom and not the typo.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="Traffic"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="N"><gen type="number" distribution="poisson" lambda="Trafic * 0.5"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{N}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-whole-run-column-under-a-condition
cases.description: running, stat and a formula that reads prev() are whole columns — the rows before this one, or all of them. An if= asks for a value chosen row by row, and the two cannot both be true. (A plain formula and a date offset read only their own row, so they may be an if= branch — see cases/branch-derived.json.)
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="T"><gen type="text" value="hi,lo"/></sequence><sequence name="N"><gen type="number" value="4..4"/></sequence><sequence name="F"><gen if="T == hi" type="running" of="N" accumulate="sum"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{F}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-computed-column-inside-a-uniq-group
cases.description: A group REARRANGES finished columns until each record is unique. A drawn value means the same wherever it lands; a computed one describes the row it was computed for. Measured before this check: two rows of five said that ten times three is twenty.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="5" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="1..5"/></sequence><uniq><sequence name="F"><gen type="formula" expr="A * 10"/></sequence><sequence name="B"><gen type="number" value="1..5"/></sequence></uniq></env><block><line><data>${{F}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-compute-inside-a-uniq-group
cases.description: The same rule from the other side: a processor has no pool to draw from and no column of its own to rearrange, so inside a group it used to be accepted and then quietly do nothing — five rows, two identical records, no message.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="5" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="1..5"/></sequence><uniq><sequence name="C"><compute><result><field name="A"/></result></compute></sequence><sequence name="B"><gen type="number" value="1..5"/></sequence></uniq></env><block><line><data>${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-way-of-reading-a-file-that-does-not-exist
cases.description: read= has exactly one value. A misspelling would otherwise fall back to the ordinary read and produce a plausible column that is not what was asked for.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="A"><gen type="file" src="x.txt" read="quantle"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: two-readings-of-one-file-at-once
cases.description: weight= puts the shares in a second column; read="quantile" says the values ARE the distribution and how often one appears is its share. Asking for both leaves the engine to pick whichever branch it reaches first.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="A"><gen type="file" src="x.csv" column="v" weight="c" read="quantile"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-sampling-mode-without-a-distribution-to-sample
cases.description: sample= chooses between drawing from the distribution and sweeping it evenly, and a file read as a plain list of values has no distribution to sweep.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="A"><gen type="file" src="x.txt" sample="exact"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: walking-a-list-and-sampling-a-distribution-at-once
cases.description: order="sequential" hands out the file's lines one after another; the quantile read says where on the sorted sample a row lands. Different jobs, and only one of them can be done.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="A"><gen type="file" src="x.txt" read="quantile" order="sequential"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: formula-without-expr
cases.description: A formula column that never says what to compute — the attribute that IS the column is missing
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="H"><gen type="number" value="150..200"/></sequence><sequence name="W"><gen type="formula"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{W}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-running-total-inside-a-case
cases.description: A <case> holds some rows and not others; a running total is the sum of every row before this one. `check` used to call this valid and the run stopped with `gen type "running" not yet supported`.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="4" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="N"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><mix name="C"><case><data>-</data></case><case><gen type="running" of="N" accumulate="sum"/></case></mix></env><block><line><data>${{N}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-statistic-inside-a-switch-default
cases.description: The same for a statistic over the run, in the `<default>` of a `<switch>`.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="4" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="N"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="K"><gen type="text" value="a,b"/></sequence><switch name="C" on="K"><case is="a"><data>-</data></case><default><gen type="stat" of="N" op="mean"/></default></switch></env><block><line><data>${{N}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-formula-reading-prev-inside-a-case
cases.description: A formula that reads prev() needs the row before its own, so it is built in row order over the whole run — a whole column, like a running total.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="4" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="N"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><mix name="C"><case><gen type="formula" expr="prev(N, 0) + N"/></case></mix></env><block><line><data>${{N}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-running-total-as-the-fallback-branch
cases.description: The fallback after the if= branches is a branch too, and it used to slip past the if= rule because it carries no if= of its own.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="4" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="N"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><gen if="N > 5" type="text" value="big"/><gen type="running" of="N" accumulate="sum"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{N}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-formula-as-a-part-of-a-composed-sequence
cases.description: A record’s parts are drawn together and rearranged together; a computed value moved to another row no longer describes it. Declare it as a sequence of its own and compose it where the record is printed.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="4" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="N"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><data>id-</data><gen type="formula" expr="N * 2"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{N}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-date-offset-as-a-field-of-a-compound
cases.description: The same for a date offset as a named field. It used to lose of= and plus= here in silence and draw an unrelated date.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="4" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="N"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="D"><gen type="date" value="2020-01-01..2020-12-31" format="YYYY-MM-DD"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><gen name="due" type="date" of="D" plus="1d"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{N}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: an-http-column-inside-a-uniq-group
cases.description: A <uniq> group MOVES values between rows, and a service's answer belongs to the row it was asked for. Measured before this check: 197 of 200 hashes in a group beside their password column landed on another row, and the run exited 0.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="4" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="P"><gen type="text" value="x,y"/></sequence><uniq><sequence name="A"><gen type="text" value="a,b,c"/></sequence><sequence name="H"><gen type="http" src="http://127.0.0.1:9/" in="P"/></sequence></uniq></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: an-http-column-inside-a-distinct-group
cases.description: A <distinct> group asks a member for ANOTHER value, and a service answers each row once: every retry was the same request again, a thousand times, before the run gave up.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="4" seed="s" local="en"><distinct><sequence name="A"><gen type="text" value="a,b"/></sequence><sequence name="H"><gen type="http" src="http://127.0.0.1:9/"/></sequence></distinct></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: an-http-column-inside-a-mix-member-of-a-uniq-group
cases.description: A <mix> member carries its cases' values, so a service called inside one moves with the mix.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="4" seed="s" local="en"><uniq><sequence name="A"><gen type="text" value="a,b,c"/></sequence><mix name="M"><case><gen type="http" src="http://127.0.0.1:9/"/></case><case><gen type="text" value="-"/></case></mix></uniq></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: an-http-column-reading-a-uniq-group-from-outside-is-accepted
cases.description: The way the hint points: the group arranges the inputs, and the http column outside it reads them after the arrangement, so each hash stays with its password.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="4" seed="s" local="en"><uniq><sequence name="P"><gen type="regex" value="[a-z]{6}"/></sequence><sequence name="A"><gen type="text" value="a,b,c"/></sequence></uniq><sequence name="H"><gen type="http" src="http://127.0.0.1:9/" in="P"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: parent-on-a-running-total-is-refused
cases.description: A running total reads the rows before this one, so "only the paid rows" could mean two different columns. Refused rather than guessed; the hint moves parent= to the column it reads.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="api" local="en"><sequence name="Status"><gen type="text" value="paid,pending" percent="50,50"/></sequence><sequence name="Amount"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="R" parent="Status.paid"><gen type="running" of="Amount" accumulate="sum"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{R}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: parent-on-a-statistic-is-refused
cases.description: A statistic reads every row of the run. It used to ignore parent= and report a total over all of them after a clean check.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="api" local="en"><sequence name="Status"><gen type="text" value="paid,pending" percent="50,50"/></sequence><sequence name="Amount"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="S" parent="Status.paid"><gen type="stat" of="Amount" op="sum"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{S}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: parent-on-a-formula-that-reads-prev-is-refused
cases.description: prev() reads the row before this one, which under a parent may be a row the parent did not pick. The condition belongs in the expression.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="api" local="en" mode="sequential"><sequence name="Status"><gen type="text" value="paid,pending" percent="50,50"/></sequence><sequence name="Amount"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="W" parent="Status.paid"><gen type="formula" expr="prev(W, 0) + Amount"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{W}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: parent-on-a-plain-formula-or-date-offset-and-on-the-column-a-total-reads-is-accepted
cases.description: The forms that stay: a formula and a date offset read only their own row, and a running total or statistic over a parent-filtered column skips its empty cells.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="api" local="en"><sequence name="Status"><gen type="text" value="paid,pending" percent="50,50"/></sequence><sequence name="Amount"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="Day"><gen type="date" value="2026-01-01..2026-12-31" format="YYYY-MM-DD"/></sequence><sequence name="F" parent="Status.paid"><gen type="formula" expr="Amount * 2"/></sequence><sequence name="Due" parent="Status.paid"><gen type="date" of="Day" plus="7d" format="YYYY-MM-DD"/></sequence><sequence name="Paid" parent="Status.paid"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="R"><gen type="running" of="Paid" accumulate="sum"/></sequence><sequence name="S"><gen type="stat" of="Paid" op="sum"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{F}} ${{Due}} ${{R}} ${{S}}</data></line></block></tdc>
